item.title: 🔴 China-Linked Hackers Exploit Critical VMware vCenter Zero-Day to Gain Admin Access and Steal Data
item.description:
Why this matters: Authentication bypass — review access controls and look for unauthorized access.
The suspected China-nexus cyber espionage group known as Armory Castle (formerly UNC5221) has been attributed to the zero-day exploitation of a critical security flaw in VMware vCenter Server in early September 2026. item.title: 🔴 VMware patches vCenter zero-day exploited in attacks since September
item.description:

Broadcom has released security updates to fix a critical VMware vCenter Server authentication bypass vulnerability that Chinese-linked hackers have exploited in zero-day attacks since September 2026. [...]

item.title: 🔴 Newly Patched VMware vCenter Flaw Exploited as Zero-Day by Chinese APT
item.description:
Why this matters: Advanced threat activity — review privileged access, persistence detection, and lateral-movement controls.

Google says a China-linked espionage group exploited a critical VMware vCenter authentication bypass before Broadcom released a patch.

The post Newly Patched VMware vCenter Flaw Exploited as Zero-Day by Chinese APT appeared first on SecurityWeek.
